description_en: Lists projects that match the specified criteria
description_zh: 批量查询满足条件的项目
kebab_example: aliyun devs list-projects --label-selector templateName=spring-boot-v3 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --keyword spring-boot --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProjects

parameters.help_en: An array of label selectors to filter projects based on the `labels` field. The operation returns only projects that match all specified selectors. The selectors are combined with a logical AND
parameters.help_zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
parameters.name: label_selector

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Defaults to 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of projects to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A keyword for a case-insensitive fuzzy search on the `name` field of projects
parameters.help_zh: 模糊搜索关键词。仅支持实体的name字段，且大小写不敏感
parameters.name: keyword
